attributes.name: BungeeCord Proxy
attributes.description: Classic Minecraft proxy. Download BungeeCord.jar from https://ci.md-5.net/job/BungeeCord/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/bootstrap/target/BungeeCord.jar

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# BungeeCord install script. Server files: /mnt/server
apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -yqq curl ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "$BUNGEE_VERSION" ] || [ "$BUNGEE_VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    BUNGEE_VERSION=lastSuccessfulBuild
fi
echo "downloading BungeeCord (${BUNGEE_VERSION})"
curl -fsSLo "$SERVER_JARFILE" "https://ci.md-5.net/job/BungeeCord/${BUNGEE_VERSION}/artifact/bootstrap/target/BungeeCord.jar" || {
    echo "download failed"; exit 1
}
echo "BungeeCord installed"
